channel.title: Hotel Management Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hotel Management Magazine (hotelmanagement.com.au)

item.title: Exclusive: inside Hilton's strong signing momentum with Vice President APAC, Paul Hutton - Hotel Management
item.description: It has been a quarter filled with a series of signings capped with this week's latest, news of its lifestyle brand, Motto by Hilton, arriving in Sydney in 2027. Daisy Melwani talks to Hilton's Paul Hutton, Vice President APAC, Head of Australasia & South Pacific, on the group's growth trajectory.

item.title: British Airways set for Melbourne return with new daily London flights - Hotel Management
item.description: British Airways is adding Melbourne to its global route network from January 2027 with the launch of daily flights from London Heathrow via Kuala Lumpur, marking the first time in 20 years the carrier has flown to Victoria.

item.title: Garner becomes IHG’s fastest growing brand in company history - Hotel Management
item.description: Garner hotels, a midscale conversion brand within the IHG Hotels and Resorts (IHG) portfolio, has celebrated reaching 100 open hotels globally since its August 2023 launch, the company’s fastest ever brand to scale globally.

item.title: Hyatt’s Essentials portfolio continues solid growth across the United States - Hotel Management
item.description: Hyatt Hotels Corporation’s Essentials portfolio is continuing solid growth across the Southeastern United States, with more than 30 Hyatt Studios, Hyatt Select, Hyatt Place, and Hyatt House hotels representing approximately 4,000 rooms in its executed pipeline.

item.title: Exclusive: growth plans unlocked with Radisson Australasia's Director of Development, Danilo Curcuruto - Hotel Management
item.description: Accelerating expansion across Asia Pacific with multiple signings in this year’s first quarter alone, Radisson Hotel Group Director of Development, Australasia, Danilo Curcuruto discusses pipeline growth with HM Editor Daisy Melwani.

item.title: Yotel becomes first brand in newly launched, Select by Hilton - Hotel Management
item.description: Hilton has signed a franchise agreement with Yotel, marking the first independent brand of the newly established lifestyle segment, Select by Hilton.

item.title: Key appointments: MGallery Collection, JW Marriott, Peppers, Wild Bush Luxury, Rosewood - Hotel Management
item.description: A wave of top-tier talent joins JW Marriott, Peppers, Wild Bush Luxury, Rosewood Kauri Cliffs, and a historic MGallery Collection hotel.

item.title: Jean-Michel Cousteau Resort unveils multi-million dollar renovations - Hotel Management
item.description: Jean-Michel Cousteau Resort in Fiji will reopen next week, following the completion of a resort-wide multi-million dollar renovation,the most extensive in the property’s history.

item.title: European hotel transactions rise 30 per cent as continent sees strong demand - Hotel Management
item.description: The European hotel investment market saw another year of strong performance in 2025 with total transaction volume reaching €22.6 billion, a rise of 30% on the previous year, according to global hotel consultancy HVS London and its hotel brokerage arm HVS Hodges Ward Elliott.

item.title: Exclusive: CEO Sajad Bassam and Founder Clare Davies dive into Capstone-Marsden merger - Hotel Management
item.description: The merger of Capstone Hotel Management and Marsden Group has created New Zealand’s largest locally owned, independent hotel management platform, boasting a portfolio of 45 properties. In an exclusive with HM, CEO Sajad Bassam and Capstone Founder Clare Davies discuss the group's future strategy.
